output.question: What is CleanSpark's short interest?
output.answer: CleanSpark (NASDAQ: CLSK) had 78,727,139 shares sold short as of October 30, 2026—the latest reported position available as of November 11, 2026. MarketBeat reports this as 31.31% of the public float, down 0.03% from the previous report, with 4.57 days to cover. These are reported positions, not a live short-interest count. ([marketbeat.com](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/CLSK/short-interest/))
